paragraphs: He is mentioned in Temurah 24a: he recited [a tannaitic teaching] before Rav Papa.[^1]

notes.text: תני קמיה means that Shimi recited a teaching before Rav Papa; “[a tannaitic teaching]” makes the conventional sense of תני explicit without inventing a particular teaching. כד. gives Temurah 24a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Both Rav titles are explicit.
